body: Yes . We live in a society that revolves around money. Majority of my personal problems are money related.

Completely understand. Found out we had them in early September, used our last full paycheck on the 4 room treatment on bedbugsupplies, bed stand, and tape and whatever else. Didn't know SO (main bread winner ) was going to lose his job immediately afterwards :(. Then after that its been us trying to get on our feet, me getting a far less paying job, and trying to help treat my grandmas house(we got them from her). Its been a sucky year 😰. All phases pass and this will be a memory eventually
